According to the different degree of risk of DDI,the pharmacist took different intervention measures.RESULTSFrom May 2O2O to April 2021, the pharmacist provided pharmacy services to l89 referred patients，and a total of 1o8 DDIs were identified. The drugs that of-ten caused DDI with DAA were Chinese patent medicine or Chinese herbal medicine（38%），gastrointestinal drugs(18.5%) and hypertension drugs (12%). The intervention measures proposed by the pharmacist to the patient mainly included stopping the combined medication (42.6%），adjusting the medication time（24.1%）and strengthening clinical monitoring（17.6%).CONCLUSION Ful-time pharmacists in pharmacy clinic can help patients optimize treatment by assessing the appropriateness of DAA treatment，determining DDI and recommending appropriate interventions to patients.KEYWORDS： － ；
